# Matthew Sullivan

> Full-Stack Developer in Arizona. At EHMA.ai he works on wAve, an AI-powered solar sales platform. In his own time he builds free, open-source accessibility tools: Sprout AAC, a communication app for kids, and ClearPath, a browser extension that makes websites easier to read.

The portfolio is a single page at https://matthewsullivan.dev/, plus a brand guide at https://matthewsullivan.dev/brand/.

## Work
- EHMA.ai: owns wAve across the full stack. In 11 weeks set up CI/CD and monitoring, raised test coverage by 828%, cut API response times from 18 s to 316 ms, migrated 556K records with no downtime, and overhauled personal-data handling.
- Ciena (2023–2025): Embedded Software Engineer and, before that, SQA Developer, after Ciena acquired Tibit.
- Tibit Communications (2021–2023): manufacturing software engineer; built a device branding station and a network statistics web interface that ships in the Tibit/Ciena PON Manager product.

## Projects
- [Sprout AAC](https://sproutaac.org): free, open-source AAC app built in Flutter. v0.1.0 is out for macOS; iOS/Android builds and Open Board Format support are in progress.
- [ClearPath](https://clearpathext.com): open-source browser extension for read-aloud, reading mode, symbol overlays and text simplification (uses the reader's own LLM API key). Not yet in browser stores.
- [Redacted Records](https://theredactedrecords.com): booking and portfolio site built for a Phoenix mixing and mastering engineer.
- [Python: First Contact](https://python-first-contact.vercel.app): Python study quiz with an in-browser Python sandbox.

## Education
- B.S. Software Engineering, Arizona State University (Polytechnic campus)

## Brand
- Logo: the "MS signal mark", a waveform M that turns into a circuit-trace S with a solder pad at each end, inside a pink-to-violet ring. The M is a signal (music, oscilloscopes), the S a PCB trace (embedded roots).
- Colours: ink #0E0B18 background, pink #EC4899, violet #A78BFA; deep pink #BE185D and deep violet #7C3AED for text on white.
- Type: Inter and JetBrains Mono.
- Guide and downloads: https://matthewsullivan.dev/brand/
